# BigQuery geography function documentation: ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/geography_functions.md

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(10 1, 20 1)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(10 2, 20 2)'), 100000)
=> "false"

# Thresholds on either side of the documented directed and undirected distances.

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(20 70, 70 60, 10 70, 70 70)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(20 90, 30 90, 60 10, 90 10)'), 2000000, directed => TRUE)
=> "true"

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(20 90, 30 90, 60 10, 90 10)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(20 70, 70 60, 10 70, 70 70)'), 2000000, directed => TRUE)
=> "false"

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(20 70, 70 60, 10 70, 70 70)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(20 90, 30 90, 60 10, 90 10)'), 2000000, directed => FALSE)
=> "false"

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(20 70, 70 60, 10 70, 70 70)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(20 90, 30 90, 60 10, 90 10)'), 2000000)
=> "false"

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(20 70, 70 60, 10 70, 70 70)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(20 90, 30 90, 60 10, 90 10)'), 6000000)
=> "true"

# Zero distance is included; NULL geographies propagate as documented.

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 0)
=> "true"

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 3 0, 0 3, 0 0))'), 0, directed => TRUE)
=> "true"

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN(NULL, ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), 1)
=> null

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY), 1)
=> null

# BigQuery observations: empty and full inputs, and threshold boundaries.

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), 1)
=> null

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), 1, directed => TRUE)
=> null

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), 1)
=> null

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), 1, directed => TRUE)
=> null

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), 1)
=> null

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), 1, directed => TRUE)
=> null

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), 1)
=> "false"

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), 1, directed => TRUE)
=> "false"

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), 1)
=> "false"

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), 1, directed => TRUE)
=> "true"

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), 1)
=> "false"

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), 1, directed => TRUE)
=> "false"

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), -1)
=> "false"

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), CAST('NaN' AS FLOAT64))
=> error: ST_HausdorffDWithin: ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN argument distance cannot be NaN; error in ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN expression

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), CAST('+inf' AS FLOAT64))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), CAST('-inf' AS FLOAT64))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), NULL)
=> null

SELECT ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1), 1, directed => NULL)
=> null


# SAFE. converts the observed NaN error to NULL.
SELECT SAFE.ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), CAST('NaN' AS FLOAT64))
=> null
